notes.title: Abtos Covert Version 1.2: The Endless Mode Update
notes.content:
Greetings soldiers! A brand new major update for Abtos Covert is now available.
 
Introducing the Endless Mode - an intense new gameplay mode where you'll have to face progressively difficult enemies. Instead of waiting for your shift to be over, see how well you've mastered the outpost's defence systems and how long you'll last against the variety of enemies coming at you.
 
The Photo Mode has also received a complete visual overhaul, expanding the existing keyboard-based menu and implementing a new slider-based approach, along with new spawnable entities, including animals. The Fox, Deer and Boar, as well as the Girl and Lykaon, can be placed anywhere on the map and you can take their picture. Also, several new effects have been added, like the flashlight and CCTV overlay, as well as the ability to take screenshots directly from the game in supersized rendering quality.
 
We'd like to thank our entire virtual photographer community for embracing our Photo Mode and providing useful feedback, with special thanks to Ludovic "Shinobi" Helme and Mik Bromley (The Fourth Focus) for their valuable input and detailed assessments of what was implemented properly and which aspects needed improvement.
 
We love to see your Photo Mode creations, and we're eager to hear your feedback on the Endless Mode, as well as any other features you'd like to see added or improved.
 
You can reach us on our Steam Community Hub, Discord Server, and other social media noted on our Steam Page.
 
Thank you again for your continued support, everyone. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Abtos Covert Version 1.1: The Photo Mode Update
notes.content:
Greetings soldiers! A brand new major update for Abtos Covert is now available.

Introducing the much-anticipated photo mode, allowing our brave players to capture the eerie and desolate atmosphere of the outpost. Get up close or take a bird's eye view – the horrors await your artistic touch.

As we promised on our previous patch, we're committed to translating the game to other languages to expand the community of Abtos Covert, and introduce more players to the horrors of our desolate outpost. This update adds 5 new languages: 

[list]
[*] French
[*] Hungarian
[*] Russian
[*] Chinese
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[/list]

You can access all these new languages on the gameplay menu. Some technical terms might not be translated (like graphics settings, for example), but tapes, notes, VHF monologue and other story texts are all proper.

We can't wait to see your Photo Mode creations and findings, and we're eager to hear your feedback on the new languages, as well as languages you want to see added in future updates. 
You can reach us on our Steam Community Hub, Discord Server, and other social media noted on our Steam Page. 

Thank you again for your continued support. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Abtos Covert Version 1.0.3 Released!
notes.content:
Greetings soldiers! A new patch for Abtos Covert is now available.

Patch Notes:

• LOCALIZATION: We're starting to add more languages to Abtos Covert, the first one being Greek!
• Steam Cloud: Enabled Steam Cloud saves.
• Credits issue fixed: Fixed an issue where the credits scene didn't load properly.
• Ending cutscene fixed: Fixed some issues on the ending cutscene.
• Balancing: balanced some enemies, specifically the Girl on Night 3.
• Level improvements: some harsh shadows on moss removed, and other improvements.
• Interaction prompts fixed: Fixed an issue with interaction prompts.
• Subtitle sync improved: Fixed some desync issues with subtitles on the Night 1 VHF Briefing.

We're very excited to start localizing the game for non-English speakers, so be on the lookout for more languages coming to future patches. Thanks for playing and being active on our Steam Community Hub and Discord Server. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Abtos Covert Version 1.0.2 Released!
notes.content:
Greetings soldiers! A new patch for Abtos Covert is now available.

Patch Notes:

* Achievement misfires & non-triggers: resolved some achievements not triggering properly.
* Resolved loading bugs: fixed some loading problems that caused the game to load twice, or not registering proper win & lose conditions.
* Resolved settings problems: fixed settings not saving properly.
* Minor map issues: fixed some out of bounds triggering earlier than expected and some level geometry.
* Added notes: added a second page on the barracks and storage notes.
* Baptism: Changed Jill's name to "Katerina".
* Resolved Lykaon framedrops: temporarily removed Lykaon's fur to address frame drops.

We've been watching your videos, streams, and reading all your feedback and we've been hard at work fixing any issues that you've encountered to make sure Abtos Covert is an enjoyable experience for you. We hope you enjoy the game, and keep us updated on the Steam Community and our Discord for further support.

Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Update 1.1.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41014639/62f1f62be463d7baa4a15f8c27e263edd5b83125.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Thank you so much for the feedback that you gave us about Abtos during the Steam Next Fest!

The team managed to fix all the critical bugs and issues of the demo, but we still didn't have time to fix some minor issues. On this update release, we focused fixing some annoying minor bugs and visual artefacts.

[h2]Demo Patch Version 1.1.5[/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
-Soldier does not chill out anymore and continue his journey
-We fixed some tapes that couldn't play
-We applied a WD40 to the lever and now it works properly
-Now all the paintings are clickable
-We fixed a weird bug with the our player movement
-Fixed Door UI
-Fixed Quality settings

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
-First night is now more difficult 
-Volume slider can now mute the sound
-The Front Spotlight lever is now in a better position

[h3]Issues[/h3]
- Ultrawide monitors are still not fully supported. A future patch will add support for 21:9

Thank you for your feedback and your support,

The Abtos team
